classification.coreAppendixExamples: Six repository-owned BasicEntity fixture checks: complete positives, grouping/string positives, and one intentional missing-ELSE negative followed by its prescribed correction; no installed-provider claim.
classification.tableExamples: Seven repository-owned fixture mappings cover TABLE/COUPLE positives, parameters, all-types explicit projection, nullable syntax, settings profiles and read modifiers; the unsupported-encoding behavior is disclosed as a fixture-provider boundary.
classification.binaryAndTextExamples: Eight explicit BinaryEntity/TextEntity fixture checks cover PNG, Apache, mixed protocol, COBOL and storage examples; published defects retain permanent negative controls and no installed-provider claim is made.
classification.metadataExamples: The missing-provider MQ3010 boundary is compared with the independent diagnostic catalog and a corrected repository-owned provider fixture.
classification.unexecutedRemainingExamples: None within REC-141 obligations; arbitrary prose commands and installed-provider behavior remain explicitly unclaimed.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target example uses Signature: byte[8] magic [0x89, ...]; bound 4.9.1 permits byte-list values after const or magic, not check.

reproduction.observed: The published form produces MQ2001_UnexpectedToken at '[' during Parse; the corrected magic-list form executes in the explicit BinaryEntity fixture.

proposedResolution.decision: Change only the target-local published PNG example from check Signature = [byte list] to magic [byte list].
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: The bound grammar assigns byte-list validation to magic/const and reserves check for a Boolean expression.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target removes literals for delimiters consumed by until and uses literal ' ' after Protocol: until '"'.

reproduction.observed: The published schema compiles but the fixture fails at runtime with ISE0004 at ApacheLog._ because until already consumed the delimiter before the redundant literal.

proposedResolution.decision: Remove redundant literals after until captures and change the post-Protocol literal from '" ' to ' '.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: The bound specification says until consumes its delimiter; the corrected schema matches the fixture input without changing engine behavior.

reproduction.observed: The published query binds Max against string Timestamp and produces MQ3088_NoMatchingCallableOverload.

proposedResolution.decision: Parse the text timestamp with ToDateTimeWithFormat and aggregate it with MaxDateTime.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: Timestamp is a text capture and these are the bound callables for the stated last-seen operation.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target declares the unsigned sync word as ushort le check Sync = 0xAA55.

reproduction.observed: The published short form reaches runtime and fails its 0xAA55 check with ISE0002 at MessageFrame.Sync; corrected ushort form returns PING and sensor 7 for two explicit frames.

proposedResolution.decision: Change the target-local sync field from signed short to unsigned ushort.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: 0xAA55 is an unsigned 16-bit protocol word and is not represented by the published signed form.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target uses ToDateTimeWithFormat(r.LastUpdate, 'yyyyMMdd') for the text date field.

reproduction.observed: The published query names nonexistent ParseDate and produces MQ3086_UnknownCallable at Bind; corrected fixture returns the documented customer, address, balance and date.

proposedResolution.decision: Change the target-local ParseDate call to ToDateTimeWithFormat.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: ParseDate is not in the bound callable surface; ToDateTimeWithFormat accepts the documented text and format.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target declares SubRecord before StorageRecord, so Nested: SubRecord[NestedCount] is definition-before-use.

reproduction.observed: The published order references SubRecord before declaration and compilation reports MQ2030 at Nested; corrected order compiles and executes the explicit storage fixture.

proposedResolution.decision: Move SubRecord before StorageRecord in the target-local example.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: The bound schema language retains definition-before-use and does not require a forward-reference relaxation.

reproduction.observed: The published nullable long offset fails compilation with MQ9001/CS1503 when passed directly to the int offset API; the explicit conversion and null fallback compiles and executes.

proposedResolution.decision: Convert the nullable long header offset to int with ToInt32 and make the missing-offset fallback explicit.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: InterpretAt requires an int offset while DataOffset is a nullable long generated from the header.

authorityAndTarget.passage: Corrected target explicitly projects all 20 declared columns instead of relying on star expansion.

implementationBoundary.fact: ShouldIncludeColumnInStarExpansion filters arrays and non-primitive types.

reproduction.observed: The published select-star form is valid but returns 17 columns and omits TimeSpanCol, GuidCol and ObjectCol; corrected explicit projection returns all 20 values.

proposedResolution.decision: Replace the published select-star form with an explicit projection of all 20 documented columns.
proposedResolution.normativeJustification: The engine star boundary filters non-primitive/complex columns; an all-types example must explicitly select the columns it promises to demonstrate.

approval.request: Approve the target-local documentation corrections identified by executable REC-141 examples. No production engine change, immutable authority edit, installed-provider execution, or publication is requested.
approval.approvalText: approved all current and further documentation corrections.

review.summary: Reviewed all eight authority/target conflicts, preserved published negative controls, verified explicit fixture mappings, checked independent catalog metadata and retained no-installed-provider boundaries. No production code changed.

boundary: Supplied authority snapshots remain immutable; their hashes and the target baseline are retained.
